package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/endpoint"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/parameters"
)

func wrong() endpoint.Input[int64] {
	header, _ := parameters.NewHeader("X-Count", parameters.Optional(parameters.CanonicalInt64(1, 9)), 1, "")
	return endpoint.Header(header)
}
